messages:
oliver: Heads up 6a7 UI error toast when a model fails to load. Current text: "Model failed to load" with a Retry button. Feels vague for users. Figma: https://figma.redwood/model-load-error
maya: Agree, we should tell users what happened and next steps. Options:
 - "Model failed to load. Try again or check model configuration."
 - "Error loading model: insufficient resources. Retry or switch model."
 - Short mobile: "Load failed. Retry." :thinking_face:
hannah: Platform note: we sometimes get an early 503 from the runtime or an OOM. Can we surface a non-technical message + an expandable details link for error codes/logs? Example body: "Couldn't load the model. Retry or view error details." and a small link "View details" that opens logs.
ops-bot: When available include error code in details. Payload example for details panel:
```
{
  "code": "OOM",
  "region": "us-west-2",
  "request_id": "req_1234"
}
```
sam: Accessibility: toast must be announced by SRs. Use role="alert" for immediate announcement and include aria-live polite for details panel. For keyboard users the Retry button needs clear focus state. Also ensure the toast can be dismissed via Esc.
maya: Tone: avoid scary words like "failed" alone. Maybe "Couldn't load this model right now" then explain action. Final candidate: "Couldn't load model. Retry or view error details." CTA primary: "Retry" secondary link: "View details". Mobile primary: "Retry" only.
oliver: I like that. Also add small helper tooltip on View details: "Includes request id and runtime hint". For persistence maybe make the toast sticky for 10s then auto-dismiss unless hovered.
hannah: Implementation note: when error code is OOM show a helper suggestion: "Try a smaller model or reduce batch size" in the details. Also log analytics event when user clicks Retry.
ops-bot: Ticket #4680 auto-created with chosen copy and ARIA guidance. Figma frame id: figma://frame/model-load-error/9. (auto-note)
sam: Small a11y nit: role=alert can be noisy; if we have multiple toasts cluster them and announce summary only. Add reduced-motion classes for dismiss animation.
maya: Finalized copy lock: Body: "Couldn't load model. Retry or view error details." Primary CTA: "Retry" Secondary link: "View details" Details panel shows error code + suggestion when available. OK to ship?
oliver: Approved. I'll add unit tests for focus, Esc dismiss, and SR announcement. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
